{{Quote|Colonel, if we were expecting the pirates to jump us, and they did not, was this mission a success?|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], to [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]|<ref name="IJ" />}}
The '''Battle of Alakatha''' was a skirmish between [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and the [[Invids|Invid]] pirates.

==Prelude==
The [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] had learnt that the [[Invids]] pirates led by the former [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Leonia Tavira]] had planned to raid the planet [[Alakatha/Legends|Alakatha]]. The [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']] and two [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]] were dispatched in the system to prevent the attack. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] was sent earlier to Alakatha and hid in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]].

==The battle==
{{Quote|This is Captain Corran Horn of the New Republic Armed Forces. I will accept your surrender.''"<br />"''Don't you know, Invids never surrender?''"<br />"''Not true of the ''Booty Full''.|Corran Horn and a female pirate pilot|<ref name="IJ" />}}
Contrary to the massive attack force expected, one [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] and eighteen [[Ugly/Legends|uglies]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] arrived in the system and engaged a [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]], the ''[[Glitterstar]]''. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] ordered Rogue Squadron to attack the pirates without waiting any reinforcement. Thanks to the element of surprise and their fighting skills, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] quickly destroyed all the enemies fighters and forced the cruiser to surrender.

==Aftermath==
When the New Republic fleet arrived in the system, the battle was already finished and all pirates eliminated. Questions arisen about the informations collected about the Invids attacks.
